python3 -c "
import trimesh, numpy as np
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
print('trimesh vols', w.volume, b.volume)
sw = section.to_manifold(w); sb = section.to_manifold(b)
print('manifold vols', sw.volume(), sb.volume())
import manifold3d
print('overlap type:', type(sw ^ sb), 'vol', (sw^sb).volume())
# rotate wheel instance by -17 about [0,0,4]: replicate _pose matrix
M = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.radians(-17), [0,0,1], [0,0,4])
print('matrix sample', M[:2,:])
sw2 = sw.transform(M[:3,:])
print('moved vol', sw2.volume(), 'overlap at -17:', (sb ^ sw2).volume())
# also via trimesh meshes
w2 = w.copy(); w2.apply_transform(M)
print('trimesh moved bounds', w2.bounds)
"
